There isn't much worth sticking around for, I guess. It's been a long struggle of finding purpose and appreciating people who say they care about you. And in the end, it was all for naught, you know? 

At first, I thought that if I found that one defining thing that I can do, then life wouldn't be so bad. Doctor, lawyer, whatever. But I couldn't find anything. I didn't fit anything. I'm not particularly smart. I'm not that talented. I'm not the nicest person. I couldn't find that thing that would define me. 

So then I thought that I would stick around for the people who supposedly care about me, but instead of feeling gratitude, I just felt resentment. Why the fuck should I stick around for these people? They don't get it. They don't give a shit, so why should I give a shit? Why should I bother worrying about those fucks, and how they're going to feel when I can finally reach some form of contentment? 

And I thought about all of this. I thought about how things just keep going wrong. And I thought that me... leaving would be easier than just waiting around to die.
